# Brandhome Museum

> > Archive of Brandhome's identity-driven brand building work, showcasing the Brandhome method, visual identity design, and Triple-A brand philosophy developed by Erik Saelens and team in Antwerp.

This museum site preserves Brandhome's portfolio of logo design, retail branding, and strategic brand consulting work from 2012-2013. It features client case studies for brands like VAB, BASE, and scarlet, alongside insights on neuromarketing, brand loyalty, and the agency's distinctive approach to craftsmanship in brand design.

## Key Topics

- Brandhome method
- Triple-A brands philosophy
- Visual identity design
- Logo design and logomarks
- Erik Saelens (founder)
- Identity-driven brand building
- Neuromarketing and brand loyalty
- Retail and POS design
- Craftsmanship in design
- Client case studies
- Brand consulting
- Antwerp and Falconplein location
- Intellectual property in branding
- Consumer research methods

## Agency Overview

- [BRANDHOME - identity driven brand building](https://museum.brandhome.com/2012/default.asp.html): Brandhome homepage showcasing identity-driven brand building services
- [brands we work with](https://museum.brandhome.com/2013/brands-we-work-with): Brandhome client portfolio featuring VAB, scarlet, BASE, and others

## Design Work & Portfolio

- [Logos & visual marks](https://www.museum.brandhome.com/2013/work/logomark/): Brandhome logo design and visual identity work showcase
- [Retail, POS & packaging](https://museum.brandhome.com/2013/work/retail): Retail activation, point-of-sale design, and packaging work showcase
- [ZONIQ](https://museum.brandhome.com/2013/work/zoniq-post): ZONIQ mobile roaming brand positioning case study for BASE telecom

## Brand Insights & Articles

- [Neuromarketing and brand churches](https://museum.brandhome.com/2013/bla/neuromarketing-and-brand-churches): Article on neuromarketing and brand loyalty featuring Apple and Coca-Cola
- [Politics & branding](https://museum.brandhome.com/2013/bla/politics-branding): Analysis of political party branding in Belgian/Flemish politics
- [Brand portraits - Gore-Tex](https://museum.brandhome.com/cgi-bin/museum.brandhome.com/cgi-bin/bhac4e.html): Brand portraits and stories featuring Gore-Tex innovation history
